state.question: Two capacitors C and 2C are separately charged to voltage magnitude V, then disconnected from all batteries. They are connected in parallel with opposite polarity and allowed to settle through arbitrarily small positive wire resistance. Still connected and isolated, a dielectric of relative permittivity 3 is slowly inserted to fill only the original C capacitor, without changing plate geometry. What fraction of the total initial stored electrical energy remains stored in both at the end?
state.notation: pi is the circle constant; i is the imaginary unit; ln is natural logarithm; sqrt is the nonnegative square root; c is light speed; hbar is reduced Planck constant. * denotes multiplication and ^ a power.
